region: Left column of Мой друг, from Вот он бредет through этот стих!; all 19 consecutive physical printed lines, excluding the heading.

coordinate_system.origin: top-left of the original source image
coordinate_system.bounds: Inclusive approximate text-ink bounds; no deskewing or coordinate rotation.
coordinate_system.x_right: Rightmost printed text ink, including terminal punctuation and excluding unrelated speckle or illustration.
coordinate_system.y_center: Midpoint of y_top and y_bottom for the complete physical line, not a baseline. Bounds span the tilted line and can overlap those of a neighboring line.
coordinate_system.x_left: Approximate leftmost printed text ink; indented continuations remain separate physical lines.

provenance.method: Visually opened the original image, an enlarged ungridded crop, a coordinate-grid crop, and more detailed coordinate-grid crops. Manually read coordinates against the grids. No OCR, automated connected components, edge extraction, or target endpoint algorithm was used to obtain these annotations.
provenance.display_transforms: Rectangular crops and 2x, 3x, or 4x enlargement for viewing only; all saved annotation coordinates are in the original 1500x2000 image.
provenance.selection: One readable photographic text column, selected before any endpoint algorithm results were inspected; reserved as held-out data and not used for tuning.
caveats: These are model-generated visual estimates, not independent human gold or subpixel measurements.
Photographic blur, faint punctuation, paper texture, and line tilt justify approximately plus or minus 5 pixels of uncertainty.
The manually read text is an identification aid, not an OCR accuracy reference. Blank stanza gaps are not lines; short indented continuations and terminal punctuation are retained.

lines.text: Ступает в лужи и не видит их,
Прописки нет, и денег тоже нет.
Но парня как-то не тревожит это:
Плевал он на прописку, он — поэт!
Держась за бок, в поту, от боли
О том, что Правда победит, писал он,
